name: Hotel Almhof
beschreibung: Hotel Almhof is located in Neustift im Stubaital, Tirol. The location offers access to hiking and skiing areas. The hotel's amenities include rooms with bathroom, a dining room, and a wellness area. The surroundings offer nature and mountains for activities. Guests can make use of the accommodation and meals during their stay. The hotel is ideal for a relaxing and active holiday.
